scripts.test:unit: bun run scripts/run_tests.ts test:nas-unit test:vscode-approval test:mitmproxy-addon-unit test:masking-unit test:process-supervisor-unit test:sumi-unit test:runner-unit test:release-unit
scripts.test:integration: bun run scripts/run_tests.ts test:nas-integration test:mitmproxy-addon-integration test:sumi-integration
scripts.test:nas-unit: bun run scripts/run_tests.ts test:nas-ts-unit test:hostexec-unit test:mask-filter-unit
scripts.test:hostexec-unit: cd src/hostexec/intercept && zig build test --summary all
scripts.test:mask-filter-unit: cd src/mask-filter && zig build test --summary all
scripts.test:masking-unit: cd lib/masking && zig build test --summary all
scripts.test:process-supervisor-unit: cd lib/process-supervisor && zig build test --summary all
scripts.test:sumi-unit: cd contrib/sumi && zig build test --summary all
scripts.test:sumi-integration: cd contrib/sumi && zig build && zig build extract-fixtures && ./tests/run-tests.sh
scripts.lint:biome: biome check src/ tests/ scripts/ contrib/vscode-nas-approval/ main.ts
scripts.fmt: biome format --write src/ tests/ scripts/ main.ts
scripts.check: bun run lint && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p src/ui/frontend/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p src/ui/frontend/tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.vendor: rm -rf src/docker/mitmproxy/vendor && uv pip install --target src/docker/mitmproxy/vendor -r src/docker/mitmproxy/vendor-requirements.txt
